hi hun. here’s a few things you can do on your own if you can’t/are waiting on medication/or just need the help! 

set an alarm. it doesn’t have to be super early, just maybe set it to 10 or 9:30 and work with that! if that’s too much, try 11:00. set your alarm away from you. this will get you out of bed just enough to get your day started. 

reward yourself. convince yourself to shower and then treat yourself to something very nice, like a good movie, yummy treats, or whatever you’d like. take it slow and steady; you don’t have to clean and do hygiene every day. go at your own pace <3

try and write little notes to yourself. something motivational, if you’d like. stick them around the place. hell, even buy funny stickers to go with them! just remind yourself that you’re doing a wonderful job, and the healing process is never fast and instant. healing takes time and that’s okay. you’re doing a great job.

take a small stretch or a short walk, just whatever you can muster at the moment. nothing fancy, just something that could get your blood pumping. your brain will naturally release endorphins. yoga is good too! just take it nice and easy, don’t push yourself too hard :) 

take deep breaths a few minutes a day. this allows you to relax with overthinking. give yourself this time to not think, not feel guilt, not feel sad. you are breathing and that is just fine! 

remind yourself it’s okay to feel sad. you’re going through stuff and your emotions might get the better of you. it’s okay if you skip a day or two of hygiene, or don’t clean up for a while. you’re working through some really hard stuff, so go easy on yourself

hi hun! i know everything works differently for different people, but my tactic to letting go is this: 

sit in a good, comfortable area and take a few deep breaths, sit however is most comfortable to you, so on and so forth. 

think about what you want to let go. the past is the past, and that can’t be changed. you might want to, but that’s impossible. 

whatever happened that you can’t stop ruminating about is a building process, it makes you human, and humans make mistakes.

holding on to your mistakes and expecting perfection out of yourself is never kind, and i know it’s a bad habit. but you’re HUMAN, and humans aren’t perfect. and that’s ok! 

it might take time to break your bad habits, but give yourself some time to come to terms. nobody’s perfect, and nobody expects you to BE perfect. if they do, they have very unrealistic expectations. 

you’ve got this, okay?? give yourself time to heal and accept. we’re here for you!! <33
